entry.title: PEEK 1.0.8
entry.summary: New: PEEK for Linux - VST3, LV2 and a standalone app (64-bit, built on Ubuntu 22.04). Checked with pluginval like the Windows version.

entry.title: PEEK 1.0.7
entry.summary: The window opens as large as you left it - also after closing and reopening the DAW (before, it came back at the smallest size). A new instance starts at the size you used last. Saving your own sounds fixed: the save window now opens inside the plugin (before, it could open hidden behind the DAW's plugin window, so nothing got saved). If Windows keeps apps out of the Documents folder, your sounds are saved in AppData instead. A failed save now says so.

entry.title: PEEK 1.0.6
entry.summary: A Peak-style 8- or 16-voice hybrid poly: three oscillators with shape, VSync, saw density and 60 wavetables, linear FM, ring mod and noise, a 12/24 dB LP/BP/HP filter between two drives, three looping envelopes, four LFOs, a 16-slot mod matrix and 4-slot FX matrix, arp, distortion, chorus, delay and reverb. ECO and HIGH quality.

entry.title: PEEK 1.0.4
entry.summary: MPC: die vier Peak-Seiten, das Display groß im MENU-Feld (die Menütasten blättern durch ihre Seiten, die Werte im Display sind die Regler); VOICES (8/16) und QUALITY auf jeder Seite.
